name: Qwen Edit Multiangle
description: Camera-aware edits for Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 with Lightning + multi-angle LoRA

action.description: Camera-aware edits for Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 with Lightning + multi-angle LoRA
action.name: qwen/qwen-edit-multiangle

aspect_ratio.description: Aspect ratio for the generated image
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

go_fast.description: If num_inference_steps is omitted, true runs the 4-step fast preset and false runs the 40-step detailed preset.
go_fast.title: Go Fast

lora_scale.description: Strength applied to the selected LoRA.
lora_scale.title: Lora Scale

move_forward.description: Move the camera forward (zoom in). Higher values push toward a close-up framing.
move_forward.title: Move Forward

num_inference_steps.description: Explicit denoising step count (1-40). Leave blank to use the go_fast presets (4 or 40 steps).
num_inference_steps.title: Num Inference Steps

rotate_degrees.description: Camera rotation in degrees. Positive rotates left, negative rotates right.
rotate_degrees.title: Rotate Degrees

seed.description: Seed value for random number generator. Uncheck for reproducible results.
seed.title: Seed

true_guidance_scale.description: True classifier-free guidance scale passed to the pipeline.
true_guidance_scale.title: True Guidance Scale

use_wide_angle.description: Switch to a wide-angle lens instruction.
use_wide_angle.title: Use Wide Angle

vertical_tilt.description: Vertical camera tilt. -1 = bird's-eye, 0 = level, 1 = worm's-eye.
vertical_tilt.title: Vertical Tilt
